title: Smoked Asparagus Kebabs
description: Grilled asparagus skewers infused with the smoky flavor of Turkish spices, perfect for a quick and easy snack or side dish.
instructions: Thread asparagus spears onto skewers, leaving a small space between each spear.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Brush the kebabs with the spice mixture, making sure to coat each spear evenly.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender and slightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or lemon wedges if desired.
